Only 14 ft wide: keep the sofa facing the west wall so the walk from the front door to the kitchen stays clear.
Opens off the shared space, so no hallway eats up square footage.
Within a few feet of the water heater, so hot water arrives fast.
Off the office, which keeps the air handler away from both bedrooms.
Fits a full bed one day: order the front window at emergency-egress size from the start.
